title: 723. Range Module

examples.explanation: After tracking 10-20, the query 10-14 is fully covered. Removing 14-16 leaves 10-14 still covered.
Two touching ranges merge into 10-20, so the full query succeeds.
Adding then fully removing the same span leaves nothing covered.

hints: Store disjoint half-open intervals in an ordered map from start to end; merging and splitting stay local to neighbors.
For addRange, widen the new span over every overlapped entry before inserting once.

For queryRange, only the interval starting at or before left matters; removal may trim one interval into two pieces. Adaptation: operations and args run in parallel and only queryRange emits output (1 for true, 0 for false).
